cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Make Help Define Us
cards.instruction: Get their help, then use how it is offered to redefine what the relationship means.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Carry the table with me, not for me. I'd like us to be partners today.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm stronger. I can do it alone.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. That's the arrangement I'm trying to stop calling our friendship.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Thank you. Now ask where we're putting it instead of deciding for both ends.
